Fix: Prevent final payment override for explicitly sized Annuity loans

This change prevents pyloan from forcing a balloon payment to clear the
remaining balance on the final payment date for Annuity loans where
the user has explicitly provided a `payment_amount`. This allows the
expected recurrence relation (remaining balance = opening balance +
rounded interest - payment) to continue for the final payment,
enabling incomplete amortization schedules. A regression test is
included.
